payload.entry: wire-fixtures done in bob-mac-capture. Models: parse/completion grammar (nil when absent, never defaulted), completion initial_selection (+opensWithoutSelection), directive span directive/count, directive candidate token/summary/detail (id includes token), clip status/count with required status and mode-only-when-read (header removed), template.directive replacing template.header, route-only CaptureGlobalDestination (mode/blockID/scopeSummary removed; captureUsesGlobalDestination is route-only; notification/panel helpers use destinationLabel). Fixtures: Scripts/generate-directive-fixtures.sh requires explicit BOB_BIN + BOB_CLI_DIR (clean checkout containing b290d833), verifies grammar>=2, isolated vault/config/HOME/clock, mocks BOB_CLIPBOARD_CMD/BOB_CLIPBOARD_HISTORY_CMD, dry-runs only; generated 60 directive-*/clip-* fixtures plus Tests/Fixtures/directive-fixtures-README.md from bob 0.4.0 at bob-cli a1dcb64e (grammar 2); regeneration is byte-identical. Tests: new CaptureDirectiveWireTests (grammar missing/1/2/3/mistyped, directive/count, UTF-8 ranges, disabled rows, unselected menus, template.directive, route-only globals, not_read, history/nested clips, batch captures, refusal codes, Codable round trips); migrated clip/template/global tests off old wire. Verified on athena (Swift 6.0.3, scratch copy): swift build --build-tests OK; swift test 1863 tests 0 failures; swift format lint: no warnings on new/changed lines except 3 pre-existing over-length string lines (CapturePanelModel 13769/13813, BobProcessClientTests 1484). just check-scripts passes locally (script added to docs-test bash -n list); no docs changed so docs-check not needed. macOS targets unverified: mac (kellys-macbook-pro) SSH timed out twice (tailscale reports offline); Sources/BobMacCapture edits are only scopeSummary->destinationLabel renames (NotificationService, CapturePanelModel, CapturePanelView) plus Tests/BobMacCaptureTests global-destination constructor/label updates; Scripts/bundle.sh and just typecheck-tests still need to run when the Mac is reachable. fake-bob and the old @template:/template_header fixtures were intentionally left for retire-syntax; no epic-symbol entries.
